* Rev C functional building blocks. NOT manufacturer-qualified timing models.
* Physical pin order is explicit. Model RCs/output resistances are numerical
* assumptions, not additional board components. No efficiency certification.
.SUBCKT REVC_IR2184_FUNC IN SD COM LO VCC VS HO VB
* Low-active shutdown, fixed nominal deadtime ~500ns via RC qualification.
* 1.4A source/1.8A sink clamps and 4ohm output assumption; not a fitted IC.
E_HREQ HREQ COM VALUE={0.5*(1+TANH((V(IN,COM)-1.65)/0.05))}
E_LREQ LREQ COM VALUE={1-V(HREQ,COM)}
R_HD HREQ HD 1k
C_HD HD COM 500p
R_LD LREQ LD 1k
C_LD LD COM 500p
E_HCMD HC VS VALUE={V(VB,VS)*0.5*(1+TANH((V(SD,COM)-1.65)/0.05))*0.5*(1+TANH((V(VCC,COM)-8.9)/0.05))*0.5*(1+TANH((V(VB,VS)-8.9)/0.05))*V(HREQ,COM)*0.5*(1+TANH((V(HD,COM)-0.63212)/0.03))}
E_LCMD LC COM VALUE={V(VCC,COM)*0.5*(1+TANH((V(SD,COM)-1.65)/0.05))*0.5*(1+TANH((V(VCC,COM)-8.9)/0.05))*V(LREQ,COM)*0.5*(1+TANH((V(LD,COM)-0.63212)/0.03))}
G_HSRC VB HO VALUE={LIMIT((V(HC,VS)-V(HO,VS))/4,0,1.4)}
G_HSNK HO VS VALUE={LIMIT((V(HO,VS)-V(HC,VS))/4,0,1.8)}
G_LSRC VCC LO VALUE={LIMIT((V(LC,COM)-V(LO,COM))/4,0,1.4)}
G_LSNK LO COM VALUE={LIMIT((V(LO,COM)-V(LC,COM))/4,0,1.8)}
C_HNUM HO VS 20p
C_LNUM LO COM 20p
R_HOFF HO VS 10Meg
R_LOFF LO COM 10Meg
.ENDS REVC_IR2184_FUNC

.SUBCKT REVC_LM393_FUNC OA NA PA GND PB NB OB VCC
* Output collectors sink when minus > plus; supplies modeled only logically.
E_DA DA GND VALUE={IF(V(VCC,GND)>2,V(NA,PA),-1)}
E_DB DB GND VALUE={IF(V(VCC,GND)>2,V(NB,PB),-1)}
R_DA DA FA 1k
C_DA FA GND 300p
R_DB DB FB 1k
C_DB FB GND 300p
S_A OA GND FA GND REVC_OC
S_B OB GND FB GND REVC_OC
.MODEL REVC_OC SW(Ron=10 Roff=1e12 Vt=0 Vh=1u)
.ENDS REVC_LM393_FUNC

.SUBCKT REVC_HC08_FUNC A1 B1 Y1 A2 B2 Y2 GND Y3 A3 B3 Y4 A4 B4 VCC
E_1 C1 GND VALUE={IF(V(A1,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),IF(V(B1,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),V(VCC,GND),0),0)}
E_2 C2 GND VALUE={IF(V(A2,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),IF(V(B2,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),V(VCC,GND),0),0)}
E_3 C3 GND VALUE={IF(V(A3,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),IF(V(B3,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),V(VCC,GND),0),0)}
E_4 C4 GND VALUE={IF(V(A4,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),IF(V(B4,GND)>0.5*V(VCC,GND),V(VCC,GND),0),0)}
R_1 C1 Y1 50
R_2 C2 Y2 50
R_3 C3 Y3 50
R_4 C4 Y4 50
.ENDS REVC_HC08_FUNC

.SUBCKT REVC_INV_FUNC A Y GND VCC
E_RATIO RAT GND VALUE={V(A,GND)/MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1)}
V_ONE ONE GND 1
R_PULL ONE MEM 1k
S_SCH MEM GND RAT GND REVC_SCH
C_NUM MEM GND 10p
E_CMD CMD GND VALUE={V(VCC,GND)*V(MEM,GND)}
R_OUT CMD Y 50
.MODEL REVC_SCH SW(Ron=0.001 Roff=1e12 Vt=0.45 Vh=0.15)
.ENDS REVC_INV_FUNC
.SUBCKT REVC_HC14_FUNC A1 Y1 A2 Y2 A3 Y3 GND Y4 A4 Y5 A5 Y6 A6 VCC
X1 A1 Y1 GND VCC REVC_INV_FUNC
X2 A2 Y2 GND VCC REVC_INV_FUNC
X3 A3 Y3 GND VCC REVC_INV_FUNC
X4 A4 Y4 GND VCC REVC_INV_FUNC
X5 A5 Y5 GND VCC REVC_INV_FUNC
X6 A6 Y6 GND VCC REVC_INV_FUNC
.ENDS REVC_HC14_FUNC

.SUBCKT REVC_DFF_FUNC CLR D CLK PRE Q QN GND VCC
* Edge memory with asynchronous clear priority. Used section D=/PRE=VCC.
E_CBIT CB GND VALUE={IF(V(CLK,GND)>0.5*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),1,0)}
R_DELAY CB CD 1k
C_DELAY CD GND 100p
E_EDGE EDGE GND VALUE={IF(V(CB,GND)>0.5,IF(V(CD,GND)<0.5,1,0),0)}
E_SET SET GND VALUE={IF(V(CLR,GND)<0.3*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),0,IF(V(PRE,GND)<0.3*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),1,IF(V(D,GND)>0.5*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),V(EDGE,GND),0)))}
E_RESET RESET GND VALUE={IF(V(CLR,GND)<0.3*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),1,IF(V(PRE,GND)<0.3*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),0,IF(V(D,GND)<0.5*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),V(EDGE,GND),0)))}
S_SET VCC MEM SET GND REVC_BOOL
S_RESET MEM GND RESET GND REVC_BOOL
C_MEM MEM GND 10p IC=0
R_MEM MEM GND 1T
E_Q QC GND VALUE={IF(V(MEM,GND)>0.5*MAX(V(VCC,GND),0.1),V(VCC,GND),0)}
E_QN QNC GND VALUE={V(VCC,GND)-V(QC,GND)}
R_Q QC Q 50
R_QN QNC QN 50
.MODEL REVC_BOOL SW(Ron=100 Roff=1e12 Vt=0.5 Vh=0)
.ENDS REVC_DFF_FUNC
.SUBCKT REVC_HC74_FUNC CLR1 D1 CLK1 PRE1 Q1 QN1 GND QN2 Q2 PRE2 CLK2 D2 CLR2 VCC
X1 CLR1 D1 CLK1 PRE1 Q1 QN1 GND VCC REVC_DFF_FUNC
X2 CLR2 D2 CLK2 PRE2 Q2 QN2 GND VCC REVC_DFF_FUNC
.ENDS REVC_HC74_FUNC

.SUBCKT REVC_BAT54S_FUNC A1 K2 MID
D_LO A1 MID REVC_BAT
D_HI MID K2 REVC_BAT
.MODEL REVC_BAT D(Is=1e-8 N=1.05 Rs=2 Cjo=10p Bv=30)
.ENDS REVC_BAT54S_FUNC
.SUBCKT REVC_BAT54_FUNC A NC K
D_P A K REVC_DP
.MODEL REVC_DP D(Is=1e-8 N=1.05 Rs=2 Cjo=10p Bv=30)
.ENDS REVC_BAT54_FUNC
.SUBCKT REVC_SS56_FUNC K A
D_S A K REVC_DS
.MODEL REVC_DS D(Is=2u N=1.15 Rs=0.03 Cjo=200p Bv=60 Tt=0)
.ENDS REVC_SS56_FUNC

.SUBCKT REVC_MCU_EQ PWM COM AVIN AVO AIL AIO OC DRVEN MCU ARM FAULT VA
* Ideal continuous equivalent, NOT executable STM32 firmware/ADC sampling.
* Real INA outputs and physical ADC RC branches now provide the feedback.
V_SS REF COM PWL(0 0 4m 0 24m 10 100m 10)
E_VO VO COM VALUE={11*V(AVO,COM)}
E_VIN VIN COM VALUE={11*V(AVIN,COM)}
E_IL ILRAW COM VALUE={(V(AIL,COM)-0.5*V(VA,COM))/0.5}
R_ILAVG ILRAW ILF 1k
C_ILAVG ILF COM 10n IC=0
E_VPI UV COM VALUE={0.4*(V(REF,COM)-V(VO,COM))+V(IV,COM)}
E_IREF IREF COM VALUE={LIMIT(V(UV,COM),-0.15,1)}
G_IV COM IV VALUE={IF(V(DRVEN,COM)>2,20*(V(REF,COM)-V(VO,COM))+1000*(V(IREF,COM)-V(UV,COM)),-1000*V(IV,COM))}
C_IV IV COM 1 IC=0
R_IV IV COM 1G
E_IPI UD COM VALUE={V(VO,COM)/MAX(V(VIN,COM),10)+0.04*(V(IREF,COM)-V(ILF,COM))+V(II,COM)}
E_D DUTY COM VALUE={LIMIT(V(UD,COM),0,0.9)}
G_II COM II VALUE={IF(V(DRVEN,COM)>2,50*(V(IREF,COM)-V(ILF,COM))+1000*(V(DUTY,COM)-V(UD,COM)),-1000*V(II,COM))}
C_II II COM 1 IC=0
R_II II COM 1G
V_SAW SAW COM PULSE(0 1 0 33.313333333u 20n 0 33.333333333u)
E_PWM PWM COM VALUE={IF(TIME<4m,0,IF(V(DRVEN,COM)>2,IF(V(OC,COM)>1.5,LIMIT(1650*(V(DUTY,COM)-V(SAW,COM))+1.65,0,3.3),0),0))}
* Output alert inhibits high pulses while asserted; no direct hardware latch.
* Approximate software short timer: after50ms, Vout<0.5 and Iout>0.8 for20ms.
G_TIMER COM TIMER VALUE={IF(TIME>50m,IF(V(VO,COM)<0.5,IF(V(AIO,COM)>0.8,1,-1000*V(TIMER,COM)),-1000*V(TIMER,COM)),-1000*V(TIMER,COM))}
C_TIMER TIMER COM 1 IC=0
R_TIMER TIMER COM 1G
V_ONE ONE COM 1
E_ST ST COM VALUE={IF(V(TIMER,COM)>0.02,1,0)}
S_SHORT ONE SMEM ST COM REVC_SHORT
C_SMEM SMEM COM 1n IC=0
R_SMEM SMEM COM 1T
E_MCU MCU COM VALUE={IF(TIME<3.2m,0,IF(V(SMEM,COM)>0.5,0,3.3))}
V_ARM ARM COM PWL(0 0 3m 0 3.0001m 3.3 3.1m 3.3 3.1001m 0 100m 0)
.MODEL REVC_SHORT SW(Ron=100 Roff=1e12 Vt=0.5 Vh=0)
.ENDS REVC_MCU_EQ
